title: OpenAI says it will cover the costs of developing energy-related infrastructure at its Stargate data centers to ensure they don't raise consumers' utility bills (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: OpenAI says it will cover the costs of developing energy-related infrastructure at its Stargate data centers to ensure they don't raise consumers' utility bills — OpenAI said it will pay for the costs of developing energy-related infrastructure required by its Stargate data centers …
